name: verbruik
description: A VNX mod: one status line with the usage of every subscription and the balance of the API providers. Claude from the session itself, the other providers from vnx providers usage.

vnxBin.title: vnx binary
vnxBin.description: The vnx executable that runs providers usage. A leading ~ is your home directory.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the other providers are measured again; 2 minutes at least.

warnPercent.title: Warn at (percent used)
warnPercent.description: A used percentage from this value up is shown as a warning.

errorPercent.title: Error at (percent used)
errorPercent.description: A used percentage from this value up is shown as an error.

warnBalance.title: Warn at (balance)
warnBalance.description: A balance at or below this value, in its own currency, is shown as a warning.

errorBalance.title: Error at (balance)
errorBalance.description: A balance at or below this value, in its own currency, is shown as an error.
